en.Prvo oblikuj i potvrdi trasu pomoću bije: First shape and confirm your route using the white via handles. Then add meeting places along it. Via points are not passenger pickup places; meeting-place names are optional. Finally confirm where you can stop. Meeting times are estimates along the chosen route, without live traffic data.
